description:
Read a page on fidgetlabs.io as markdown: a service, an industry, a solution, an article,
a glossary term, the pricing page or the engagement list. Pass the site path, for example
/pricing or /services/integrated-marketing. ask_fidget_labs returns the paths to read.

Pages written as components have no markdown version. For those the tool says so and
lists the paths that do.

path.description: A path on fidgetlabs.io starting with one slash, such as /pricing.

name: read_page
title: Read a page as markdown
